name: Зеленоград
point_source_note: RuWiki-derived article search excerpt reports city coordinates 55°59′52″N 37°11′25″E and administrative placement under Moscow city government in 1965 / Moscow district in 1968. Article coordinate is city representative point, not exact census-date measurement.

name: Восточный
point_source_note: Source gives OSM/Google/Yandex coordinates and describes historical settlement as the Stalin working settlement then renamed Vostochny and attached to Moscow in 1961; distinct settlement point, not modern district centroid.

name: Внуково
point_source_note: Historical PGT page reports 55°36′39″N 37°17′58″E, a settlement founded for airport staff; transferred to Moscow Leninsky district administration in 1956. Same named old urban settlement, not airport point or current district boundary.

name: Некрасовка
point_source_note: GeoNames search result labels exact name Некрасовка in Moscow as a “section of populated place”; historical urban locality page describes old Nekrasovka as worker settlement for aeration station, distinct from Lyubertsy Fields added in 2011. Point is accepted only as representative point for old locality footprint; exact historic boundary unknown.
